title: Why Your Brain Rewards You Before the Best Part of a Song
description:
In a Nature Neuroscience study, researchers scanned listeners during music. Dopamine release was found at peak emotional arousal, and the caudate was more involved during anticipation than the nucleus accumbens, which was more involved at the peak. One human imaging study; it does not diagnose or advise anyone.

#Shorts #Psychology #Neuroscience #Music #DopamineLoop

Source: Salimpoor et al., Nature Neuroscience, 2011, doi:10.1038/nn.2726 (abstract on PubMed, PMID 21217764).
